articles.title: How to use SignPad
articles.subtitle: Your daily warehouse workflow
articles.description: Follow a load from picking and labeling to inspection, loading, signatures, and the printed bill of lading.
articles.introduction: Start with a SignPad that is already paired and configured with MES. The illustrated guide uses training data: always scan your current paperwork and match the load, DC, and PO before confirming work.

sections.title: Use the picking summary
steps: Match the red LOAD number to the load you are working on.
For picking, scan the bottom-left barcode under Prepared By. It opens Confirm Picking for the load.
After labeling every DC, scan the bottom-right barcode under Checked By to open Confirm Inspection.
sections.note: Picking and inspection use the summary. Labeling and loading use the separate DC slip.

sections.title: One DC barcode, used twice
steps: Check the PO, LOAD, and DC printed at the top of the slip against the shipment in front of you.
The first scan of the barcode at the bottom of the DC slip opens labeling. Complete the labels and tap Confirm labeled.
After every DC is inspected and the inspector signs, scan the same barcode again. It now opens Confirm Loading.
sections.note: Keep the same DC slip. There is no separate loading barcode to print or find.

sections.title: Pick the load
steps: Scan the barcode under Prepared By on the picking summary. Check the load number, DC, PO, and box quantity for each shipment.
Select each shipment you have finished picking. Use Check All only when every listed shipment is ready.
Tap Confirm. The number in brackets is the number of selected shipments.
sections.note: A checked blue row is selected, but is saved only after you confirm. Next, scan a DC-slip barcode to label that shipment.

sections.title: Label each shipment
steps: Scan the barcode at the bottom of the DC slip. Match both the DC and PO; two shipments can share a DC number.
Match the DPCI, item description, and box count to the shipment, then finish the physical labeling.
Tap Confirm labeled. Repeat with the next DC slip until every shipment on the load is labeled.
sections.note: This confirms only the shipment on the scanned slip, not every shipment on the load.

sections.title: Inspect the load
steps: After every DC is labeled, scan the barcode under Checked By on the picking summary. Check the load number.
Inspect each shipment, then select its row. Check the box count on the right. Use Check All only after inspecting every shipment.
Tap Confirm. When the last DC is confirmed, the inspector signature page opens automatically.
sections.note: A yellow row with a ban icon means labeling is incomplete. Complete the missing labeling, then tap Reload details.

sections.title: Sign to release the load
steps: After all DCs are inspected, review the load number and PO/DC list on the landscape signature screen.
Draw the inspector's signature in the white area. Tap CLEAR if you need to start again.
Tap SIGN to save the inspector signature and release the load for loading.
sections.note: Next, scan the same DC-slip barcode again to confirm loading.

sections.title: Load each shipment
steps: After inspection and signing, scan the same DC-slip barcode. Verify that Confirm Loading shows the correct load number, DC, and PO.
Match the DPCI, descriptions, and box counts, then complete the physical loading for that shipment.
Tap Confirm Loading. Repeat for the remaining shipments.
sections.note: A count such as (1/2) means one shipment was already loaded out of two when the page opened. It is not the position of the current DC.

sections.title: After loading: scan the summary
steps: Finish and confirm loading for every DC slip, then use the ALL Outbound Loads Summary for the correct date.
Find the matching Load Number and scan the barcode directly beneath that load's load / PRO information.
Complete the shipper signature first, then the driver signature. Both must be saved before printing the BOL.
sections.note: Use the barcode under the correct load on the outbound summary to begin BOL signing.

sections.title: Shipper signs first
steps: On the shipper signature screen, tap SIGN to open the drawing area.
Have the shipper sign in the white area. Tap CLEAR to try again.
Tap CONFIRM. The phone moves to the driver signature.
sections.note: Hand the phone to the driver. Both parties must sign before printing.

sections.title: Driver signs next
steps: On the driver signature screen, tap SIGN to open the drawing area.
Have the driver sign in the white area. Tap CLEAR to try again.
Tap CONFIRM and wait for both signatures to save.
sections.note: When both signatures are saved, the phone offers to print the BOL.

sections.title: Print the signed BOL
steps: Wait until the phone shows Signature saved. Print the BOL?
Tap PRINT to send the signed BOL to the configured printer.
Collect the printed document and check that it is for the correct load.
sections.note: Loading and both signatures are complete. The signed BOL is ready for the shipment.
